annotations.title: Export lists as a schema sync document

description: The account's lists, their indexes and write rules (and, for a token that is allowed everything, its flows) as a schema sync document, keyed by pathName. The easiest way to start managing an existing account with schema sync. Filter by scope, tags or lists on big accounts. Needs the sync-schema permission, which alone is enough to read structure. 1 request.

scope.description: Only the lists this scope manages
